verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਇਕ ਵਰਨ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਅਵਰਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਜਾਪੈ।
verses.translit_en: chaar varan ik varan kar varan avaran saadhasa(n)g jaapai|

en.bdb: Since the true Guru integrated all the four varnas into one, this assemblage of varnas has come to be known as the holy con

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤੀ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਥਾਪੈ।
verses.translit_en: chhia rutee chhia dharasanaa gurmukh dharasan sooraj thaapai|

en.bdb: Among six seasons and six philosophies, the Gurmukh-philosophy has been established like the Sun (among the planets).

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਹ ਪੰਥ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਕੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਵਡਾ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ।
verses.translit_en: baareh pa(n)th miTai kai gurmukh pa(n)th vaddaa parataapai|

en.bdb: Wiping out all the twelve ways (of yogis) the Guru has created the mighty Gurmukh-way (panth).

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਲਾਪੈ।
verses.translit_en: vedh katebahu baaharaa anahadh sabadh aga(n)m alaapai|

en.bdb: This panth keeps itself away from the boundaries of the Vedas and the Katebas and always remembers as well as sings the uns

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਪਛਾਪੈ।
verses.translit_en: pairee pai paakhaak hoi gursikhaa raharaas pachhaapai|

en.bdb: On this Way of absolute humility and becoming dust of the feet of the Gum, the disciple learns the right conduct.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸ ਕਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਜਪੈ ਅਜਾਪੈ।
verses.translit_en: maiaa vich udhaas kar aap gavaae japai ajaapai|

en.bdb: This panth remains detached amidst maya and obliterating the sense of ego remembers the Lord spontaneously i.e. always rema
It has gone far beyond the influence of boons and curses.
